pages.title: HUD Information
pages.text: The Control Seat HUD displays the following information:$(br2)Top bar: horizontal compass directions.$(br2)Left bar: pitch angle.$(br2)Left arcs: remaining fuel and energy.$(br2)Center lines: mouse position and applied torque direction while using mouse controls.

Right arcs: remaining shield energy and heat (heat is not yet implemented).$(br2)Bottom buttons: the enabled state of the flight assists and weapon channels described earlier.$(br2)Weapon names and cooldown bars on the right: weapons active on the current channels and their cooldown state. See $(l:vsie:weapon/weapon_channel)Weapons: Channels/$.
